description: Mobilfunk-Monitoring is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodienste.sachsen.de. The map service shows the mobile phone coverage in the Free State of Saxony according to mobile phone technology. SMWA assumes no liability for the correctness, up-to-dateness and completeness of the spatial data, visualizations and contents. The data are provided by the Federal Network Agency (BNetzA) as of January 2022. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Mobile phone monitoring" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Long Term Evolution, Mobilfunkgeneration, LTE, Mobilfunkversorgung, Bundesland Freistaat Sachsen, Mobilfunk. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
